featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

​The failure of the DVR 8 days later was not due to a wrong diagnosis, but due to the unit’s condition. We regret that the spare parts manufacturer does not provide a warranty for burnt items, which is why we could not offer a free replacement. We would value the opportunity to explain this technically in person and find a cost-effective solution for you."
